symmetry: FL mirrors FR and RL mirrors RR about Y=0; X/Z values match within 1e-9 m
continuity: At +/- travel_check_m, each corner must converge on the continuation branch and produce finite non-zero strut motion ratio; mirrored corners must agree in magnitude within 1e-4.
roll_center_and_jacking: Planar front-view diagnostics are estimated only; do not use them as 3D vehicle roll-centre or jacking predictions.
